text: FAQ for Dreamforce 2026 Skip to content FAQ You’ve got questions. We’ve got answers. Event Information What is Dreamforce? Dreamforce is an annual event that brings together the global Salesforce Community for learning, connection, fun, and giving back. It’s an experience that celebrates customer success, powerful ideas, and groundbreaking innovations like Agentforce. Dreamforce is where you experience humans and agents driving customer success together and where you build your Agentic Enterprise. Established in 2003, Dreamforce has grown into far more than just a conference. It’s an experience unlike any other. From inspiring keynotes and sessions to visionary thinking and next-level innovation, it’s an empowering and inspirational gathering that transforms business and makes a global impact. Dreamforce 2027 takes place on September 21-23. Get early updates on registration, hotels, speakers, and more. Save the date today . When and where will Dreamforce take place? Dreamforce returns to San Francisco, CA, at Moscone Center, September 21–23, 2027. Plus, enjoy an exclusive broadcast experience on Salesforce+. Save the date . Registration Registration Group Registration How do I register for Dreamforce? Registration for Dreamforce 2027 will open in Spring 2027. Save the date today to stay up to date with the latest announcemnts including when registration opens. In the meantime, you can watch select sessions from Dreamforce 2026 on demand on Salesforce+ . What is a Trailblazer account? A Trailblazer account is your free, unified, single sign-on that simplifies your journey in the Salesforce ecosystem. With your Trailblazer account, you can register for events, build your agenda, stream sessions on Salesforce+ , learn new skills on Trailhead, connect with the community, and tap into personalized support — all in one place. What is Express Badge Pickup with Digital Pass? Express Badge Pickup with Digital Pass, powered by Wicket , is our exciting way to help you save time by breezing through badge pickup and when attending select keynotes. Digital Pass (via facial authentication) matches your photo to your record. It’s easy, simple, and 3x faster than general badge pickup. Opting in takes less than 30 seconds. Log in to upload your live selfie. Facial authentication will also provide access to engage in personalized onsite experiences. What are the accepted payment methods? Accepted payment methods include Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, or debit cards with a major credit card logo. What does the Dreamforce Conference pass include? The Conference pass includes access to all keynotes, breakouts and theater sessions, hands-on workshops, roundtable discussions, networking with your community, the Welcome Reception, and Dreamfest. It also includes daily morning and afternoon refreshments and lunch. Is there an age requirement to attend Dreamforce? Persons under 18 years of age are not permitted within Dreamforce or its venues. This includes the expo hall, sessions, breakouts, keynotes, and all other event activities. See Event Terms of Service . How do I register a group? Discounted group registration will be available when registration opens in Spring 2027. Save the date today to stay up to date on the latest announcements, including when registration opens. What are the accepted payment methods for group registration? Accepted payment methods include Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, or debit cards with a major credit card logo, wire transfers, and checks. Please note: If paying by check or wire transfer, you’ll be able to invite your group members only after the payment has cleared. How do hotel bookings work with group registration? Once a group pass purchase is complete, the group representative can send invitations through a simple workflow. Each person will need to complete their own registration and book their own hotel. Each attendee must complete their own registration using their unique link. During that process, they will be able to book a hotel room through aRes , our trusted third party site. Please note: Hotel booking is not available until individual registration is completed. Rooms are limited, so we recommend that attendees register and book early to secure their preferred accommodations. Can I add more attendees to my group after registration is complete? Once an initial order with a minimum order of 3 passes has been purchased, the group representative can log in to the group pass portal to purchase additional passes. Please note: Additional passes are offered at the current discounted group pass rate at the time of purchase. What is the cancellation policy for group registration? Group passes through the Group Passes Program are nonrefundable and cannot be combined with any other offer, discount, or promotion. See full terms and conditions here . Dreamfest What is Dreamfest at Dreamforce? Dreamfest at Dreamforce is the official celebration of Dreamforce and the UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospitals Concert for Kids. This event brings together everyone for an amazing night of entertainment, networking, and fun. Dreamfest is included with your in-person registration. Sessions How do I submit a session idea for Dreamforce? The call for participation for Dreamforce 2027 will open in Spring 2027. Save the date today to stay up to date on the latest announcements, including when the Call for Participation opens. Save the date. What types of sessions are available at Dreamforce? Main Keynote Don’t miss the event’s flagship session, featuring Salesforce’s biggest announcements, latest innovations, live demos, and standout customer stories. Keynote Dive deeper into a specific product, industry, audience, or topic through focused announcements, live demos, customer stories, or insights from a featured luminary speaker. Breakout Attend a dynamic 40-minute presentation focusing on a specific product or solution, followed by a Q&A session. Theater Experience a concise and informative 20-minute session introducing a specific topic. Whether it’s tips and tricks or a how-to presentation, you’ll get the essentials in a quick and engaging manner. Roundtable Gather with like-minded attendees to discuss a particular topic. This 60-minute session is an opportunity to network and share best practices and common challenges facing the Salesforce community. Moderated by an expert at each table. Workshop Participate in an expert-led, 60-minute, interactive session to learn a product or skill. The workshop description will let you know if computers are provided or if you need to bring your own device. Hands-on Training Facilitated by a Salesforce expert, this 60- to 90-minute session includes guided exercises with hands-on practice. Product experts are standing by to help, and computers are provided. Community Networking Connect with peers, community leaders, and Salesforce experts in 45-minute open discussions. Share resources, explore customer success, and gain practical career insights that help you build skills and take the next step in your Salesforce journey. How do I know what sessions will be available at Dreamforce? You can view last year's sessions on the Sessions page and search for content based on your role, industry, product, and more. How do I know what session level to attend? All sessions are available to anyone; however, finding a session that best matches your role, industry, product, and learning level will ensure the content is relevant and most applicable to you at this time. Learning Levels: Beginner Beginner-level sessions are content that is suitable for users who are new to the product or topic. These sessions may cover foundational concepts and skills and are designed to provide an introduction and get participants started with technology. Intermediate Intermediate-level sessions assume general knowledge of the topic and provide a technical deeper dive into a product, service, or use case. The content focuses on features, functions, and benefits of a product or service, showcasing how the product or service can be used and integrated with other offerings. Sessions will sometimes feature customers. Advanced Advanced-level sessions assume proficiency in the topic and typically cover in-depth content covering complex, enterprisewide use cases and strategies for the product or service, focusing on advanced features, techniques, and architectures that require significant expertise to implement. These sessions prepare participants to serve as strategic mentors and lead complex, cross-functional projects. What session resources will be available after the event? Registered attendees can visit the Sessions page or login into view their Event Recap after the conference to find select presentation materials. Limited episodes will also be available on demand on Salesforce+ . Is there reserved seating at Dreamforce? Yes, Dreamforce will have reserved seating for certifications, roundtables, workshops, and hands-on trainings. Reserving a seat for a session guarantees there will be space for you in that session, as long as you arrive at least five minutes before the start of the session. If a session you want to attend no longer has seats available to reserve, you may still be able to attend by showing up early and joining the drop-in line. For all other sessions that do not offer reserved seating, please plan to arrive early to secure your seat on a first-come, first-served basis. Is favoriting sessions the same as reserved seating? No, favoriting a session is not the same as reserving a seat in a session. “Favoriting” sessions adds sessions of interest to your favorites list. You can filter for “Your Favorites” in the session catalog on the Sessions page. To favorite a session, select the heart next to the session title and the session will appear in your calendar. You can reserve your seat for a session on the Sessions page by clicking the “Reserve” button. This session will then be added to your “My Agenda” page. If there is no “Reserve” option for a reservable session, we suggest arriving early and joining the drop-in line for the opportunity to attend. Any seats available are released to the drop-in line 10 minutes before the session start time. What does drop-in mean? The drop-in line is for attendees who didn’t reserve a seat before the event. Arrive to the session early, and once reserved attendees have entered, the remaining seats will be given to the drop-in line. Is there a limit on how many sessions I can reserve? You may reserve as many sessions as you like as long as they don’t overlap. Meaning, you won’t be able to reserve seats in sessions that occur at the same time. If you’re unable to reserve a seat for a session, you’re encouraged to join the drop-in line, in case a reserved seat is released. How early should I get to my session? Session queues open 30 minutes before the published session start time. Reserved seats are seated first, and then the remaining seats are opened to the drop-in line. Any unclaimed reserved seats are released to the drop-in line five minutes before the session start time, and is first-come, first-served seating. What should I bring to my sessions? Check individual session descriptions for specific equipment needs: Workshops : You must bring your personal laptop and charger. Phones or tablets are not supported for workshop materials. Headphones : It is recommended to bring a pair of headphones that connect to both your phone and laptop for audio or interactive content throughout campus. What are Session Summaries and where can I find them? Session Summaries are short, AI-generated recaps of Dreamforce keynotes, theater sessions, and breakouts. They highlight the key points and takeaways so you can quickly catch up on what you missed. Session Summaries will appear in three places: In the Salesforce Events mobile app on the session list and session detail pages On the Dreamforce Sessions page In your personalized Event Recap in the Attendee Portal Do all sessions have a summary and how soon after a session are they available? Most theater, keynote, and breakout sessions will have summaries. Look for the “Session Summary” button or icon on the session tile in the schedule. You can also filter the catalog by “Missed a Session?” > “Session Summary” to see all available recaps. Most summaries will be published within 24 hours of a session finishing, often sooner. Can I give feedback on a summary? Yes. Each summary includes a Report a Concern link so you can flag issues. Feedback goes directly to the event team for review and resolution. Can I access Session Summaries after Dreamforce? Yes. Session Summaries remain available in your Event Recap and online for you to revisit and share key takeaways after Dreamforce. How can I access my Event Recap or Session Summaries? Log in to the attendee portal to view your Event Recap and Session Summaries. Bootcamp What is Trailblazer Bootcamp? Trailblazer Bootcamp at Dreamforce is your opportunity to gain hands-on product expertise, elevate your skills, and build lasting connections with peers. Dive into three intensive days of hands-on learning led by industry experts, connect with fellow Trailblazers who share your passion, and take your career to the next level. Included in the Bootcamp pass is one certification voucher to save and use after the event. Bootcamp will take place at the Salesforce offices on September 12–14, 2026. What is included with the Bootcamp registration? Your Bootcamp experience includes everything you need to succeed, plus one certification exam voucher to put your new skills to the test. Three full days of instructor-led training Breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily Trailblazer Bootcamp Welcome Reception Accommodations Are there hotel blocks available for the event? Yes, Salesforce has reserved hotel blocks around San Francisco, CA. You will have the opportunity to book your room when registration opens in Spring. Inventory is limited, available on a first-come, first-booked basis. Travel Where can I find information on San Francisco? For information on things to do during your stay in San Francisco, check out the San Francisco Travel website . What is the weather like in San Francisco in September? September is one of the best months to visit San Francisco. The weather is typically warm and sunny, often the warmest month of the year. Expect daytime highs around 65–75 degrees F (18–24 degrees C) and cooler evenings around 55–60 degrees F (13–16 degrees C). Indoor conference locations are often air-conditioned. Please pack layers and check weather.com before you travel. Which airports are closest to San Francisco? San Francisco International Airport (SFO) is the closest major airport, an easy BART ride or a 25-minute drive from downtown. Alternatively, the Oakland International Airport (OAK) is a 35-minute drive over the Bay Bridge and is also accessible by BART. Lastly, the San Jose International Airport (SJC) is a one-hour drive from the South Bay, accessible by Caltrain. Is the in-person Dreamforce experience open to international travelers? Dreamforce is open to international travelers who abide by regional travel restrictions and guidelines. Additional Information Does Dreamforce have a code of conduct? Yes, please review our code of conduct. https://www.salesforce.com/company/legal/event-code-of-conduct/ At Dreamforce, I gain real-world Salesforce solutions, swap admin best practices, solve challenges with peers, and bring back ideas I can use immediately. Misty Jones Principal Systems Support Analyst, Liberty Mutual Transform every part of your business. Become an Agentic Enterprise. September 15–17, 2026 | San Francisco and Salesforce+ Watch now
